scripts.sync-bins: mkdir -p bin && cp ../beacon-host/target/debug/beacon-host ./bin/ && cp ../backend/target/debug/backend ./bin/beacon-api && chmod +x ./bin/beacon-host ./bin/beacon-api && codesign -s - -f ./bin/beacon-host && codesign -s - -f ./bin/beacon-api
scripts.sync-bins:prod: mkdir -p bin && cp ../beacon-host/target/release/beacon-host ./bin/ && cp ../backend/target/release/backend ./bin/beacon-api && strip ./bin/beacon-host ./bin/beacon-api && chmod +x ./bin/beacon-host ./bin/beacon-api && codesign -s - -f --entitlements entitlements.plist ./bin/beacon-host && codesign -s - -f --entitlements entitlements.plist ./bin/beacon-api
scripts.dev: npm run sync-bins && concurrently --kill-others "npm run vite:dev" "npm run electron:launch"
